title: Open-Source BI Service Availability
dataSources: Superset logs (`superset:app`, Celery worker/beat), Metabase logs (`metabase:app`), Redash query logs, app repository tables (query cache, dashboard views), embedding/SDK error events via HEC.
app: Apache Superset / Metabase / Redash application logs via Universal Forwarder or container stdout; Celery worker metrics and app repository databases via Splunk DB Connect.
spl:
index=bi (sourcetype=superset:app OR sourcetype=metabase:app OR sourcetype=redash:app) (level=ERROR OR msg="health check failed")
| stats count as errors, latest(_time) as last_error by sourcetype, host
| where errors>0
| sort - errors
description: Aggregates error and health-check-failure events across Superset, Metabase, and Redash so an unhealthy self-hosted BI service is caught quickly.
value: Self-hosted BI has no vendor SLA; log-based health monitoring is often the only early warning before users report an outage.
implementation: Ship application logs from each service/container; schedule every 5 minutes; alert on error bursts. Pair with container health (cat-03).
visualization: Table of errors by service/host, timechart of error rate.
grandmaExplanation: We keep an eye on your self-hosted reporting tools and flag when one starts throwing errors, before people report it down.
